# General practice

1. General medicine (5 years)
2. Internship (1 year) -> MD degree
3. Medical officer (5 years) -> GP

Patients load: 

- 30% go to GP
- 70% go to Polyclinics


# Specialist

1. General medicine (5 years)
2. Medical officer (3-4 years)
3. Registrar (3-4 years) -> Specialist diploma 
4. Associate consultant (2-3 years) -> Sub-specialty diploma (overseas)
5. Consultant (5 years)
6. Senior Consultant


## Specialities

- General surgery
- Pediatrics
- Neurology

- Anesthesiology
- Geriatrics
- Pathology

- Emergency medicine
